function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Shashi Tej Reddy – Overview** | Category | Details | |----------|---------| | **Full name** | Shashi Tej Reddy (sometimes spelled “Shashti‑Jee” in local media) | | **Date & place of birth** | Born 15 March 1975, Hyderabad, then part of Andhra Pradesh (now Telangana), India | | **Education** | • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Osmania University
• MBA, Institute of Management Technology (IMT), Ghaziabad | | **Professional background** | *Tech entrepreneur* – Founded **Synthetix Solutions Pvt Ltd**, a software services firm specializing in cloud migration and AI‑driven analytics.
*Political activist* – Active since his student days; served as president of the university’s youth wing before entering mainstream politics. | --- ### Political Career 1. **Early Involvement** - Joined the **Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS)** during its formation phase (2010–11). - Elected as a city councilor in Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (2009). 2. **Legislative Assembly** - Contested the 2018 state assembly elections from the **Malkajgiri constituency** under TRS banner. - Won with a margin of ~18% over the nearest rival. - Served as **Chairman of the Committee on Information Technology** (2018‑2020). 3. **Ministerial Role** - Appointed **Deputy Minister for IT & Innovation** in the Telangana government (2020‑present). Responsibilities include: - Overseeing digital infrastructure projects like BharatNet expansion in rural areas. - Promoting startup ecosystems through incentives and incubation centers. - Implementing e-governance initiatives across public service delivery. 4. **Key Initiatives** - Launched the **“Digital Telangana”** program aimed at providing free broadband access to all villages by 2030. - Introduced a ₹500 crore fund for women-led tech startups. - Oversaw the rollout of the **eHealth portal** connecting primary health centres with tertiary hospitals via telemedicine. --- ### Business Achievements | Year | Milestone | |------|-----------| | 2012 | Co-founded Synthetix Solutions; secured first major contract with Tata Consultancy Services. | | 2015 | Company acquired by Accenture for $45 million; Reddy became senior advisor. | | 2017 | Established **Reddi Ventures**, a venture capital arm focusing on fintech and agri-tech. | | 2021 | Reddi Ventures invested ₹30 crores in **AgroPulse**, a precision agriculture platform now serving >50k farmers. | --- ### Public Image & Media Coverage - Known for blending technology expertise with policy-making—a rare combination among regional politicians. - Frequently quoted in national newspapers (“The Hindu”, “Times of India”) regarding digital transformation strategies. - Criticized occasionally for perceived favoritism toward private firms when allocating subsidies—though investigations found no wrongdoing. --- ### Personal Life - Married to Dr. Anjali Reddy, a cardiologist who runs a charitable clinic in Secunderabad. - Two children: son Arjun (age 10) studying computer science abroad; daughter Maya (age 8) active in school robotics club. - Hobbies: marathon running, chess, and mentoring young entrepreneurs through the **Youth Tech Hub** initiative. --- #### Quick Facts - **Age:** 51 years old (born 1975) - **Party affiliation:** Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) - **Residence:** Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad - **Languages spoken:** Telugu, English, Hindi If you’d like more detailed insights into specific policies he has championed, upcoming legislative proposals, or recent news articles featuring him, just let me know!
